description: This Java class defines utility methods for handling color contrast calculations, specifically to determine if the contrast ratio between two colors is sufficient for accessibility purposes. It includes caching to optimize repeated calculations and uses an inner class to represent pairs of color values.

classes.name: NotesColorUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to check if color contrast ratios are sufficient, with caching for efficiency.

classes.name: ColorPair
classes.description: A private inner class representing a pair of color integers with custom equals and hashCode methods for use as cache keys.

methods.name: contrastRatioIsSufficient
methods.description: Checks if the contrast ratio between two colors exceeds 3.0, indicating sufficient contrast.

methods.name: contrastRatioIsSufficientBigAreas
methods.description: Checks if the contrast ratio between two colors exceeds 1.47, used for larger UI areas.
